normal.name: My little retro computer world
normal.text: Ever wondered how Silverball (1993) sounded on a Gravis Ultrasound? It was one of the very first games to support the GUS, with hardware mixing at that, and its tracker music sounded leagues better than on a Sound Blaster Pro. Recorded on 486 DX4-100, GUS 3.74 1M, MS-DOS 6.22. #retrogaming #retropc
